brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION (exact prompt):
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: One Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, preferably 1600x900 or 1792x1024, minimum width 1000 pixels.
Create exactly ONE finished image. Hand-painted sports editorial illustration, NOT a photograph, NOT a photorealistic rendering.
Article facts are limited to the supplied frozen article: 2026-11-22 games are pre-game as of 01:43 JST; B.ONE and B.NEXT games are scheduled; official results and player rankings are pending. Do not imply final scores, a selected best five, individual participation, individual performance, a victory, or an actual observed game scene.

Art direction: match the inspected approved black/lime v3 reference's visual language: deep green-black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B dry-brush energy streaks, off-white heavy Japanese typography, very strong editorial hierarchy, rough ink, brush and sparse halftone. Keep few elements and generous negative space.
Subject: exactly one REAL basketball player: 高橋耕陽 / Koyo Takahashi of Kagawa Five Arrows. He was randomly selected from a team named in the article. Do not write his name on the image. Depict him recognizably using the official team portrait inspected in the conversation ONLY as likeness reference, never paste or reproduce the photograph.
Likeness observed from official portrait: Japanese adult male, tall lean athletic build with long neck, medium-short dark brown/black tousled wavy hair, voluminous middle/top and a subtly parted fringe exposing central forehead, tapered sides, clean-shaven, slim oval face with slightly angular lower jaw, straight eyebrows, relatively narrow almond eyes, straight medium nose, small closed lips. Preserve these particular facial traits; do not invent a generic athlete or use the player from the style reference.
Clothing: plain off-white sleeveless basketball jersey and shorts with dark trim, without letters, numbers, team/league/sponsor logos, patterns or emblems.
Pose and composition: dynamic low driving dribble toward the lower left in three-quarter view, torso leaning diagonally, knees naturally bent, face visible and recognizable, one hand controlling an orange basketball near the left hip/knee and the other arm bent naturally for balance. Player occupies the left 40-43% of canvas, with the head well inside the top edge. Anatomically correct fingers and hands, exactly two arms. Editorial crop at or below knees is fine but do not clip face, hands or basketball. No other people, no spectators, no actual court/venue depiction. Energetic lime brush arc behind him, clear separation from headline.
Text occupies the right 53%, fully inside a 5% safe margin. All Japanese text accurately rendered, crisp legible heavy Gothic sans-serif. Date and headline very large; small factual status remains readable. Use exactly these text blocks, once each, with no extra text:
"バスケまとめ" (small top right header)
"11/22" (largest lime type)
"試合予定" (huge off-white type)
"B.ONE / B.NEXT" (medium off-white)
"公式記録確定待ち" (medium lime or dark text on lime brush band)
"2026.11.22 01:43 JST時点" (small but clearly readable)
Bottom edge footer with ample safe margin:
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"
Treat these as plain text, not league logos. No named-player claims, stats, jersey number, rank, best-five claim, score, versus label, or carried-over 38 points. This is explicitly a general imagined illustration, not a reconstruction of this day's game. All required text and subject must fit safely inside frame.

ONE PERMITTED REVISION (exact prompt):
Use case: identity-preserve and precise-object-edit. Make ONE correction to the existing illustrated basketball thumbnail.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the black/lime Japanese thumbnail. Input image 2 is an OFFICIAL LIKENESS REFERENCE ONLY, the portrait of the real player 高橋耕陽 / Koyo Takahashi. Do not paste or reproduce the photo and do not reproduce any logos, sponsor writing, jersey text or numbers from it.
Keep the complete right-side typography, all wording, exact dates, status, black #151A18/lime #CCF43B/off-white palette, dry-brush editorial illustration medium and dynamic driving-dribble concept.
Correct only the illustrated player on the left:
(1) Scale/reposition the player and basketball to give the entire hair/head at least 45 pixels top clearance and the entire ball and all fingers at least 35 pixels left clearance. Face, hair, both hands and ball must be fully inside the frame, not touching edges. Slight lower-leg/knee cropping is okay.
(2) Match the real face and hair in reference image 2 faithfully as a hand-painted ink illustration: hair is medium-SHORT wavy tousled black/dark brown with a subtly parted fringe, less long and less inflated than the edit target; use the reference's slim oval face, softly angular chin, narrower eyes, straight eyebrows, small closed lips and straight nose. Clean-shaven. Do not beautify into a generic manga hero, do not add facial hair. He is a tall lean adult athlete, not excessively muscular.
(3) Anatomically correct two hands, five natural digits each, one hand on the basketball and one balancing. Plain off-white sleeveless uniform with dark trim and no writing or number.
Do not add a second player. No team logos, league logos, sponsors or pasted photography. Never write the player's name or any claims about his attendance or performance. This is an imagined illustration, not an actual game recreation.
The text MUST remain exactly:
バスケまとめ
11/22
試合予定
B.ONE / B.NEXT
公式記録確定待ち
2026.11.22 01:43 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Keep all text comfortably within the frame. Preserve the approximately 16:9 landscape canvas, 1672x941 or another near-16:9 size over 1000 pixels wide.
